info.title: Bison Blog Public Static Data
info.description: Public, read-only static JSON resources for Chinese and English article discovery and reading instructions. No authentication or API keys are required. These are complete published files, not a server-side search service: there are no supported query parameters, pagination or write operations. Download and cache an index, filter locally, then read the chosen article using its url or markdown_url. Publication dates and historical version notes must be considered before recommending an app or citing code. Public access does not remove attribution or usage requirements; see https://allluckly.cn/robots.txt and https://allluckly.cn/auth.md.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: An ETag from a previous response. A matching resource can return 304 with no body.

title.description: Original article title in this index language.

category.description: Original category; null when a historical article has no category.

url.description: Absolute public article URL. Legacy paths may contain Unicode characters.

markdown_url.description: Absolute URL to the complete Markdown representation, ending in /index.md.

description.description: Plain-text article summary; may be empty.

date.description: Original article publication time including its timezone, not the app release or current compatibility date.

shortdate.description: Human-readable publication date in the format Month DD, YYYY; use date for comparisons.

author.description: Original author name where recorded; null if not recorded. Check the article for attribution and source context.

app_name.description: App name from site metadata, where available. Confirm the actual app and feature applicability in the article.

keywords.description: Article keywords; an empty array is valid.

version_note.description: Compatibility and historical-version note for development articles; empty when no note is recorded.

ChineseArticleIndex.description: All currently published, indexable Chinese articles. No pagination.

EnglishArticleIndex.description: All currently published, indexable English articles. No pagination.

url.description: Skill Markdown URL, resolved against https://allluckly.cn/ if relative.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the complete skill file bytes; verify after retrieval.
